families.axis: no fault found in it → complete and consummate perfection

members.gloss: being complete of its kind and without defect or blemish
members.tone: The unqualified standard here, claiming completeness of its kind as well as the absence of blemish, where *flawless* claims only the absence.

members.gloss: (of a record) having no marks of discredit or offense
members.tone: Praise by absence - a record with nothing marked against it, a narrower claim than the completeness *perfect* asserts.

members.gloss: free from flaw or blemish or impurity
members.tone: Reaches past flaw and blemish to impurity as well, so it can clear a substance and not only a performance.

members.gloss: marked by errorless familiarity
members.tone: Perfection as drilled familiarity - the thing is known so thoroughly that error does not arise, where *errorless* only reports that none did.

members.gloss: perfect and complete in every respect; having all necessary qualities
members.tone: Asserts that every necessary quality is present, the opposite test from *flawless*: nothing missing rather than nothing wrong.

members.gloss: perfect and complete in every respect; having all necessary qualities
members.tone: Formal and superlative where *complete* is plain, pitching the same total sufficiency as an accolade.

members.gloss: understood perfectly
members.tone: Puts the perfection in the grasp rather than in the thing - the understanding is finished, and it says so flatly.

members.gloss: understood perfectly
members.tone: The idiom tightens *down* into exactness: not merely understood but understood to the letter.

members.gloss: understood perfectly
members.tone: Dignifies the same perfect understanding as an attainment, where *down* merely reports the state.

members.gloss: free from error
members.tone: A flat count of no errors, the coolest word in the family beside *impeccable*'s admiration.

members.gloss: without fault or error
members.tone: Takes in fault as well as error, so it acquits the conduct and not just the execution.

members.gloss: without fault or error
members.tone: Lifts the same absence of fault into something untouched, admiring where *errorless* is merely accurate.

members.gloss: without fault or error
members.tone: Reads the absence of fault as a standard held to - admiration rather than measurement.

members.gloss: without fault or error
members.tone: Frames faultlessness as something kept intact rather than achieved, and in a stiffer register than *faultless*.

members.gloss: without a flaw
members.tone: Single-minded - one flaw would undo it, where *complete* asks instead whether everything is there.

members.gloss: without a flaw
members.tone: The plain negation beside *flawless*, denying the flaw without carrying the admiration.

families.axis: plain physical ease → warm, enveloping comfort

members.gloss: providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief (‘comfy’ is informal)
members.tone: The plain baseline of the set, covering both the chair and the person sitting in it, without the warmth *cozy* adds.

members.gloss: providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief (‘comfy’ is informal)
members.tone: Informal and fond where *comfortable* is plain, claiming no more ease than it does — only a softer way of saying it.

members.gloss: enjoying or affording comforting warmth and shelter especially in a small space
members.tone: Adds warmth and shelter to *comfortable*'s bare ease, the comfort of being enclosed and kept warm.

members.gloss: enjoying or affording comforting warmth and shelter especially in a small space
members.tone: Carries exactly *cozy*'s sheltered warmth; the difference is one of spelling, not of force.

members.gloss: enjoying or affording comforting warmth and shelter especially in a small space
members.tone: Puts the weight on close fit — comfort from being tucked into a small space rather than merely warmed, more bodily than *cozy*.

members.gloss: affording comfort
members.tone: The thinnest word here: it says a thing affords comfort and stops, with none of *cozy*'s warmth or *soothing*'s relief.

members.gloss: having a feeling of home; cozy and comfortable
members.tone: Locates the comfort in the feeling of home, so it praises a place for putting you at ease rather than for warmth alone as *cozy* does.

members.gloss: having a feeling of home; cozy and comfortable
members.tone: The same home-feeling approval as *homelike*, settled and unshowy — the praise is for the ease of the place, not its grandeur.

members.gloss: having a feeling of home; cozy and comfortable
members.tone: Informal where *homelike* is plainly descriptive, saying the same home-comfort more casually.

members.gloss: having a feeling of home; cozy and comfortable
members.tone: A spelling variant of *homey*, identical in its fond, informal warmth toward a place that feels like home.

members.gloss: affording physical relief
members.tone: Comfort framed as active relief — where *easy* merely affords comfort, this one implies a physical discomfort being eased.

families.axis: cool displeasure → provoked past patience into revulsion

members.gloss: not pleased; experiencing or manifesting displeasure
members.tone: The family's coolest term: it registers the absence of pleasure and lets it show, without conceding any heat to it.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: The plain, unheated name for the state: impatience or anger without the colouring that *miffed* or *steamed* add to it.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Friction rather than flare: the same impatience or anger, but felt as something rubbing on and on rather than landing once like *stung*.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Light and slightly diminishing, it sizes the impatience or anger as a small thing and the person holding it as easily put out, where *annoyed* passes no such judgement.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Prickled and smarting: the state as something that caught and stings still, sharper in point than *annoyed* and briefer than *irritated*.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Small and faintly comic, it scales the impatience or anger down to a grievance worth mentioning but not worth raising your voice over.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Vulgar and blunt, it states the same impatience or anger in the coarsest register the family has, which is everything *displeased* withholds.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Carries the coarse charge of *pissed* with the particle adding follow-through, anger sent outward rather than merely held.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Stirred up rather than simply arrived at: it puts the impatience or anger down to having been worked into someone.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Churn instead of flare, the impatience or anger turbid and unsettled all through, where *stung* is one sharp point.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: Pressure made visible, the heat contained but plainly building, hotter than *peeved* and short of the coarseness of *pissed off*.

members.gloss: aroused to impatience or anger
members.tone: The state as recoil: something landed, and the impatience or anger is the flinch back from it, where *irritated* only wears on.

members.gloss: greatly annoyed; out of patience
members.tone: The end of the line, annoyance carried far enough that patience is spent, which is exactly what *annoyed* still holds in reserve.

members.gloss: greatly annoyed; out of patience
members.tone: British and deflating: a full loss of patience carried in a phrase too offhand to shout, where *exasperated* keeps its composure.

members.gloss: greatly annoyed; out of patience
members.tone: Flat, worn British informality, the patience gone by erosion rather than blown out like *steamed*.

members.gloss: having a strong distaste from surfeit
members.tone: Strong distaste from having had too much of a thing, the surfeited turn of the stomach rather than heat aimed at anyone, and the family's furthest recoil.

families.axis: visible brilliance → excellence exalted past the human

members.gloss: having or deserving or conferring glory
members.tone: The family's full measure - glory had, glory deserved and glory handed on, where *illustrious* claims only the having and the conferring.

members.gloss: splendid
members.tone: Praise at its plainest - splendid, with none of the awe *sublime* carries or the record standing behind *storied*.

members.gloss: having an illustrious past
members.tone: The illustrious past registered as acclaim - others have noticed, which *historied* does not bother to say.

members.gloss: having an illustrious past
members.tone: The same illustrious past stated as plain fact rather than applause, and more formal for it than *celebrated*.

members.gloss: having an illustrious past
members.tone: The illustrious past turned into something worth recounting - it implies a tale, where *celebrated* implies only admirers.

members.gloss: being of such surpassing excellence as to suggest inspiration by the gods
members.tone: Excellence pushed past the human scale until it reads as god-given rather than merely achieved.

members.gloss: being of such surpassing excellence as to suggest inspiration by the gods
members.tone: The most rarefied way to say that same god-touched excellence - ornate where *divine* is direct.

members.gloss: being of such surpassing excellence as to suggest inspiration by the gods
members.tone: The mildest of the three - it credits the surpassing excellence to something breathed in from outside without naming the gods as *divine* and *elysian* do.

members.gloss: inspiring awe
members.tone: Awe pitched at its loftiest and most ornate, where *sublime* delivers the same awe in a word that can be said plainly.

members.gloss: inspiring awe
members.tone: Matched to *empyreal* in force - awe as sheer altitude, something the eye has to be raised to.

members.gloss: inspiring awe
members.tone: Awe that arrests rather than merely pleases - the word here that admits to being overwhelmed.

members.gloss: having or conferring glory
members.tone: Glory as both possession and gift - it holds glory and lends it out, without *glorious*'s further claim that the glory is deserved.

members.gloss: characterized by ardent emotion or intensity or brilliance
members.tone: Praise for a white heat, whether of ardent feeling, of intensity or of sheer brilliance - it burns where *lustrous* only shines.

members.gloss: brilliant
members.tone: Brilliance as a finish on the surface - it gleams, where *incandescent* burns from inside.

families.axis: simply not put into words → lodged in the nature of the thing itself

members.gloss: implied though not directly expressed; inherent in the nature of something
members.tone: Neutral and two-sided, covering both the meaning that was never spelled out and the one that sits in a thing's nature, where *unspoken* reaches only the first.

members.gloss: implied though not directly expressed; inherent in the nature of something
members.tone: Built as a negation, it frames the same implicitness as a shortfall in the telling, where *implicit* frames it as a property of the thing.

members.gloss: in the nature of something though not readily apparent
members.tone: A relational phrase rather than a quality — it must name the thing the sense is lodged in, which the bare adjectives beside it need not do.

members.gloss: in the nature of something though not readily apparent
members.tone: The firmest claim of the three: not hidden by accident but built into what the thing is, and so not detachable from it.

members.gloss: in the nature of something though not readily apparent
members.tone: Puts the sense beneath a surface rather than inside a nature, implying something could be uncovered, where *inherent* makes it permanent.

members.gloss: implied by or inferred from actions or statements
members.tone: The plain everyday word for a meaning that rides along with an act or a statement without being spoken, lighter in weight than *tacit*.

members.gloss: implied by or inferred from actions or statements
members.tone: Formal, and it treats the unspoken meaning as settled and binding — something one is held to, which *silent* does not insist on.

members.gloss: implied by or inferred from actions or statements
members.tone: Adds successful uptake: the meaning was not merely implied but taken up on both sides, where *tacit* says only that it went unsaid.

members.gloss: not made explicit
members.tone: Neutral and general — it says the thing found no outward form at all, without insisting that words in particular were what went missing.

members.gloss: not made explicit
members.tone: The plainest of the negatives, and it carries a faint sense of something held back, where *unexpressed* is a flat report.

members.gloss: not made explicit
members.tone: Dry and procedural, marking the absence the way one notes a missing entry, beside the more human *unsaid*.

members.gloss: not made explicit
members.tone: Elevated and faintly literary, shaping the omission as something never let out rather than merely never recorded.

members.gloss: not made explicit
members.tone: Clinical in register, framing the gap as a failure to convert into words rather than a silence with any weight to it.

members.gloss: not made explicit
members.tone: The British spelling of the same clinical term, identical in force to *unverbalized*.

members.gloss: not made explicit
members.tone: Implies a voice was available and went unused, which gives it more pull than the flat *unverbalized*.

members.gloss: not made explicit
members.tone: The most loaded of the plain negatives — what is unspoken feels present and deliberately left alone, where *unstated* is only a blank.

families.axis: pushing in where one is unwanted → offensive meddling in what is not one's business

members.gloss: tending to intrude (especially upon privacy)
members.tone: The plain term for the fault: it names the pushing-in itself, without the added charge of trespass that *encroaching* carries or the contempt in *meddlesome*.

members.gloss: gradually intrusive without right or permission
members.tone: Stresses the slowness of it - the ground is taken a little at a time, so no single step looks like the violation that *invasive* makes it sound.

members.gloss: gradually intrusive without right or permission
members.tone: The same gradual advance, framed as spread into ground that is not its own, where *encroaching* keeps the emphasis on the edging forward.

members.gloss: gradually intrusive without right or permission
members.tone: Puts the intrusion in terms of a line crossed without permission, naming the wrong outright where *encroaching* only lets it accumulate.

members.gloss: intrusive in a meddling or offensive manner
members.tone: The flattest of the meddling group - it faults the getting-in-the-way rather than heaping on the contempt that *meddlesome* carries.

members.gloss: intrusive in a meddling or offensive manner
members.tone: Makes the offensive prying a settled trait of the person, not the single act that *meddling* catches them at.

members.gloss: intrusive in a meddling or offensive manner
members.tone: Condemns the deed in progress, where *meddlesome* condemns the character behind it.

members.gloss: intrusive in a meddling or offensive manner
members.tone: Formal and cold beside the homely *busybodied*, delivering the same charge of offensive meddling as a verdict rather than a complaint.

members.gloss: intrusive in a meddling or offensive manner
members.tone: An everyday word carrying the whole meddling charge, so the disparagement lands quietly where *officious* announces itself.

members.gloss: intrusive in a meddling or offensive manner
members.tone: Turns the offender into a type, dismissing the whole person rather than the one act *meddling* points to.

families.axis: regrettably unsuitable → graceless to the point of incompetence

members.gloss: not appropriate in application; defective
members.tone: Formal and softened - it marks a thing as both misapplied and defective while keeping an apologetic surface, where *inept* simply condemns.

members.gloss: not elegant or graceful in expression
members.tone: Mild - the expression stumbles without collapsing, and no verdict is passed on the ability behind it, unlike *inept*.

members.gloss: not elegant or graceful in expression
members.tone: Heavier than *awkward* - the expression is not merely ungainly but handled with a thick hand.

members.gloss: not elegant or graceful in expression
members.tone: Faults the expression for weight and unwieldiness, landing on the shape of the thing where *clumsy* lands on the handling.

members.gloss: not elegant or graceful in expression
members.tone: The dry, measured option - it records an expression as not fitting, with none of *clumsy*'s picture of bungled handling.

members.gloss: not elegant or graceful in expression
members.tone: The hardest of these words - it shifts the fault from the phrasing to the ability behind it, so gracelessness reads as incompetence.

members.gloss: not elegant or graceful in expression
members.tone: Blames the selection rather than the person, faulting the words picked where *inept* faults whoever picked them.

members.gloss: unsuitable or regrettable
members.tone: The gentlest wording available - it calls a thing unsuitable and regrettable at once, treating the fault as bad luck rather than bad work.

families.axis: mild wish for advancement → ambition pressed past what it can carry

members.gloss: having a strong desire for success or achievement
members.tone: The plain name for the desire itself, favourable but only mildly, and carrying no fault until *overambitious* attaches one.

members.gloss: marked by aggressive ambition and energy and initiative
members.tone: States the aggression as a quality of the person and still counts the energy and initiative in, so it stings less than *pushy*.

members.gloss: marked by aggressive ambition and energy and initiative
members.tone: The complaint form of that same drive: the energy is conceded, the aggression is what the word is actually for.

members.gloss: desiring or striving for recognition or advancement
members.tone: Formal and cool — it registers the reaching for recognition or advancement without any verdict on it, where *aspiring* sounds warm.

members.gloss: desiring or striving for recognition or advancement
members.tone: Treats the reaching as a credit to the person, though it promises nothing beyond the wanting and the effort themselves.

members.gloss: desiring or striving for recognition or advancement
members.tone: Puts its weight on the wanting rather than on any force behind it, making it the gentlest way to say what *pushy* says harshly.

members.gloss: strongly motivated to succeed
members.tone: Frames the motivation as something that has hold of the person, so it lands closer to a diagnosis than to the compliment *determined* pays.

members.gloss: strongly motivated to succeed
members.tone: The approving way to say it — the motivation reads as steadiness of will rather than as pressure, which is what separates it from *driven*.

members.gloss: strongly motivated to succeed
members.tone: Keeps the admiration but not the comfort: the motivation is felt as something pushing from behind rather than chosen.

members.gloss: unfulfilled or frustrated in realizing an ambition
members.tone: Formal, and it files the ambition as one that came to nothing — the same verdict *would-be* delivers far more bluntly.

members.gloss: unfulfilled or frustrated in realizing an ambition
members.tone: Deflating in one stroke: it grants the ambition and withholds the achievement in the same breath.

members.gloss: excessively ambitious
members.tone: Turns the quantity of the ambition into the fault, condemning as excess exactly what *ambitious* merely reports.
